roadmap.goal: ADO Bug #6071: Lighthouse disagrees with itself about the defaults of a new Team and Portfolio. The Team entity defaults ThroughputHistory to 30 while both UI create paths send 90; Team.FeatureWIP defaults to 1 while the UI sends 0; Portfolio.PercentileHistoryInDays defaults to 90 while the UI sends 0 (and the backend fallback `?? 90` catches only null, so a stored 0 samples a zero-day window). The server also accepts a throughput history of 0 or less. Fix: one named default per setting per stack (ThroughputHistory 90, FeatureWIP 0, PercentileHistoryInDays 90), a server-side rejection of throughput history <= 0 when fixed dates are not used, and removal of the dead code the RCA found.

validation.notes: Bugfix flow (/nw-bugfix Phase 3) - minimal roadmap, no DISCUSS/DESIGN/DISTILL waves for this bug. RCA and decisions D1-D4 approved by the maintainer (see rca.md, 'Maintainer decisions'). Four steps: backend defaults, backend validation, frontend defaults + quick setting, and a separate refactor step for dead code (maintainer asked for a separate commit).

out_of_scope: A migration or data fix for Teams already stored with ThroughputHistory <= 0. They keep showing 'Cannot forecast' until someone sets a positive value; the new validation makes them fix it on the next save. Existing Portfolios with PercentileHistoryInDays 0 are handled by the backend fallback, not by rewriting rows (expand-only migrations).
Validation of Portfolio PercentileHistoryInDays on the server. The maintainer asked for rejection of <= 0 for Team throughput history only; the Portfolio settings form already requires >= 30.
A backend endpoint that serves defaults to the frontend. It was removed deliberately in babe81f99; each stack keeps one named constant.
Docs prose, screenshots and release notes - handled at finalize.

phases.name: Regression tests and fix for ADO Bug 6071
phases.description: A new Team or Portfolio gets the same defaults whichever route creates it, and a Team cannot be saved with a throughput history of 0 or less.

steps.name: Backend defaults for new Teams and Portfolios live in one named place each
steps.description:
TDD execution. Read docs/feature/fix-throughput-history-default/rca.md first, especially 'Maintainer decisions'.

**RED** - Unit tests (new or extended test class near the existing Team / Portfolio model tests under `Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/Models/`): (1) `new Team().ThroughputHistory` equals `Team.DefaultThroughputHistoryDays` and that constant is 90; (2) `new Team().FeatureWIP` is 0; (3) `new Portfolio().PercentileHistoryInDays` equals `Portfolio.DefaultPercentileHistoryInDays` (90). WorkItemService test (find the existing test class covering the percentile-based default amount of work items, around `WorkItemService.cs:718`): a Portfolio with PercentileHistoryInDays 0 (and one with a negative value) samples the same 90-day window as one with null. Tests (1) and (2) and the WorkItemService 0-case must fail on current code.

**GREEN** - `Models/Team.cs`: `public const int DefaultThroughputHistoryDays = 90;` used as the ThroughputHistory initialiser; FeatureWIP initialiser becomes 0 (a named constant only if it reads better; 0 means 'not set' and the forecast treats it as 1 in `SimulatedRun.cs:114`). `Models/Portfolio.cs`: `public const int DefaultPercentileHistoryInDays = 90;` used as the initialiser. `WorkItemService.cs:718`: use the constant and treat null or <= 0 as the default. Then fix every existing backend test that silently relied on the old implicit 30 / 1 (set the value explicitly in the test's arrange block, or its builder, rather than changing the assertion's meaning). Demo data (`Factories/DemoDataFactory.cs`) follows the entity default; check its tests and any demo snapshot expectations still hold and update them if they encoded 30.

**COMMIT** - `fix(team): give new Teams and Portfolios one default per setting`. Body references Bug #6071 and carries `Task-Id: fix-throughput-history-default`. Comments per CLAUDE.md: rare, plain-language why, no internal references.

**Quality gates:** consult docs/ci-learnings.md first. From `Lighthouse.Backend/`: `dotnet build` zero warnings; `dotnet test --filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"` green (environmental failures listed in CLAUDE.md are not regressions).
criteria: A Team created without an explicit throughput history samples 90 days, read from Team.DefaultThroughputHistoryDays
A Team created without an explicit Feature WIP has Feature WIP 0
A Portfolio created without an explicit percentile history has 90 days, read from Portfolio.DefaultPercentileHistoryInDays
A Portfolio stored with percentile history 0 or less computes its default feature size from the 90-day window
dotnet build has zero warnings and the filtered dotnet test is green
steps.scenario_name: New Teams and Portfolios get one default per setting
red_to_green_tests: A new Team defaults to 90 days of throughput history
A new Team defaults to Feature WIP 0
A Portfolio stored with percentile history 0 uses the default window
deliverables: Named default constants on Team and Portfolio
Backend tests updated where they relied on implicit defaults

steps.name: The server rejects a Team throughput history of 0 or less
steps.description:
TDD execution. Read docs/feature/fix-throughput-history-default/rca.md first.

**RED** - Backend integration tests through the real HTTP pipeline (TestWebApplicationFactory; copy the setup pattern of an existing Team integration test under `Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/API/Integration/`), new file e.g. `TeamThroughputHistoryValidationIntegrationTest.cs`: (1) POST /api/latest/teams with throughputHistory 0 and useFixedDatesForThroughput false -> 400; (2) same with -5 -> 400; (3) PUT /api/latest/teams/{id} with 0 -> 400 and the stored value is unchanged; (4) PUT with 0 but useFixedDatesForThroughput true and valid dates -> accepted (the rolling window is unused then); (5) POST with the throughputHistory property omitted from the JSON -> 400 (already true because of [JsonRequired]; this pins it so the bind-to-0 path cannot come back). Also unit tests in the existing TeamsController / TeamController test classes for the 400 on create and update. Cases 1-3 must fail on current code; 4 and 5 are guards that pass today - state that in the execution log.

**GREEN** - One small shared check (e.g. a static validator next to `BaselineValidationService` / `StateMappingValidator` in the API helpers, or a method on `Team`/`TeamSettingDto` - pick what matches the surrounding code) that returns an error when `!UseFixedDatesForThroughput && ThroughputHistory <= 0`, used by `TeamsController.CreateTeam` (before the Team is built) and `TeamController` PUT (alongside the existing staleness checks). Use the configurable-term-neutral message 'Throughput history must be at least 1 day.' unless the controller already builds messages with terminology. Leave `POST /teams/validate` as is unless it is the natural place to share. Confirm the Team quick setting saves through the same PUT (so step 01-03's UI change is backed by the server).

**COMMIT** - `fix(team): reject a throughput history of 0 or less`. Body references Bug #6071, carries `Task-Id: fix-throughput-history-default`.

**Quality gates:** as in 01-01, plus run the new integration test class (it is not in a live-connector category).
criteria: Creating a Team with throughput history 0 or less and no fixed dates returns 400
Updating a Team to throughput history 0 or less and no fixed dates returns 400 and leaves the stored value unchanged
A Team that uses fixed dates is not blocked by its unused rolling-window value
A create request that omits throughputHistory returns 400
Create and update share one check; build zero warnings; filtered tests green
steps.scenario_name: A Team cannot be saved with a throughput history of 0 or less
red_to_green_tests: Creating a Team with throughput history 0 is rejected
Creating a Team with a negative throughput history is rejected
Updating a Team to throughput history 0 is rejected
deliverables: Shared throughput-history check used by create and update
Integration and unit regression tests, including the pinned 400 for an omitted field

steps.name: Frontend create paths use the same named defaults and the quick setting stops offering 0
steps.description:
TDD execution. Read docs/feature/fix-throughput-history-default/rca.md first.

**RED** - Vitest: (1) `CreateTeamWizard.test.tsx` - the settings handed on for a new Team carry throughputHistory `DEFAULT_THROUGHPUT_HISTORY_DAYS` (90) and featureWIP 0 (the existing expectation at ~line 693 already expects 90; make it assert against the constant); (2) `CreatePortfolioWizard` test - a new Portfolio carries percentileHistoryInDays `DEFAULT_PERCENTILE_HISTORY_DAYS` (90), which fails today (0); (3) `ThroughputQuickSetting` test - entering 0 shows an error and does not save; the helper text no longer mentions '0 to unset'. Tests 2 and 3 must fail on current code.

**GREEN** - Export `DEFAULT_THROUGHPUT_HISTORY_DAYS = 90` and `DEFAULT_FEATURE_WIP = 0` from `src/models/Team/TeamSettings.ts`, and `DEFAULT_PERCENTILE_HISTORY_DAYS = 90` from `src/models/Portfolio/PortfolioSettings.ts`. Use them in `CreateTeamWizard.tsx` (~35/39) and `CreatePortfolioWizard.tsx` (~39). Use `DEFAULT_PERCENTILE_HISTORY_DAYS` for the display fallback in `ProjectSettings/Advanced/FeatureSizeComponent.tsx:136` instead of the literal "90". `ThroughputQuickSetting.tsx` ~169-173: reject values below 1 with '${throughputTerm} history must be at least 1 day'. Do NOT touch the Edit pages' hand-typed defaults - step 02-01 deletes them.

**COMMIT** - `fix(team): create Teams and Portfolios with the shared defaults`. Body references Bug #6071, carries `Task-Id: fix-throughput-history-default`.

**Quality gates:** consult docs/ci-learnings.md. From `Lighthouse.Frontend/`: `pnpm test` green; `pnpm build` zero errors and warnings (it runs `biome check --write` as prebuild - review what it rewrites; remove any `*/docs` symlinks first if present).
criteria: The Team wizard creates Teams with 90 days of throughput history and Feature WIP 0, read from named constants
The Portfolio wizard creates Portfolios with 90 days of percentile history, read from a named constant
The Team quick setting rejects a throughput history below 1 and no longer offers 0 to unset
pnpm test green; pnpm build zero errors and warnings
steps.scenario_name: The UI creates Teams and Portfolios with the shared defaults
red_to_green_tests: A new Portfolio gets 90 days of percentile history
deliverables: Wizards and display fallback use them

steps.name: Delete the unused configuration export model and the Edit pages' hand-typed new-item defaults
steps.description:
Refactor under green tests (behaviour-preserving except for the malformed-URL edge case below). Read docs/feature/fix-throughput-history-default/rca.md first.

**RED** - Vitest for `EditTeam` and `EditPortfolio`: `/teams/new?cloneFrom=abc` (a non-numeric cloneFrom) renders the create wizard, like `/teams/new` without cloneFrom. Same for `/portfolios/new?cloneFrom=abc`. Fails today (it renders the settings form with hand-typed defaults).

**GREEN** - In `pages/Teams/Edit/EditTeam.tsx` and `pages/Portfolios/Edit/EditPortfolio.tsx`: decide wizard-vs-form on a *valid numeric* cloneFrom (parse once), so the non-wizard path always has either a clone source or an existing id; then delete the hand-typed `defaultTeamSettings` / `defaultPortfolioSettings` objects. Delete `src/models/Configuration/ConfigurationExport.ts` (grep first: it must have no importers; remove the folder if empty). Keep every existing EditTeam/EditPortfolio test green; adjust only tests that exercised the deleted fallback.

**COMMIT** - `refactor(team): drop dead default and export code found for Bug #6071`. Carries `Task-Id: fix-throughput-history-default`.

**Quality gates:** `pnpm test` green; `pnpm build` zero errors and warnings.
criteria: A new-Team or new-Portfolio URL with a malformed cloneFrom opens the create wizard
The Edit pages carry no hand-typed defaults for a new Team or Portfolio
ConfigurationExport.ts is gone and nothing imported it
pnpm test green; pnpm build zero errors and warnings
